name: Mor'shan Rampart
summary: At Mor'shan Rampart, Horde guards hold the northern end of the Gold Road and the way into Ashenvale. The Warsong clan raised the barricade to shield Horde territory from night elf counterattacks and to stage raids into the forest.

sections.title: The Northern Gate
sections.body: At the northern end of the Gold Road, Mor'shan Rampart guards the meeting of the Barrens and Ashenvale. Its timber walls and watchtowers were raised against night elf strikes over the Horde's logging. From here, raiding parties head north toward Astranaar.

sections.title: Warsong Outpost
sections.body: Warsong fighters and sentries keep Mor'shan Rampart ready for battle. They watch the tree line for night elf scouts and archers. The post also keeps supply lines open between Ashenvale's frontline outposts and Horde settlements to the south.

faq.answer: Mor'shan Rampart guards the northern end of the Gold Road where the Barrens meet Ashenvale. Its Horde fortifications defend the Barrens against attack.
The Horde garrisons Mor'shan Rampart with Warsong fighters and sentries. They keep watch from its towers and palisades along the forest boundary.

faq.q: Why is the rampart here instead of deeper in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: Mor'shan Rampart guards the northern end of the Gold Road, the main land route between the central Barrens and Ashenvale. Holding this narrow passage makes it harder for night elf forces to strike south into Horde lands.

faq.q: Can Alliance travelers pass through the rampart safely?
faq.answer: No. Mor'shan Rampart is an active Horde military post. Its guards attack Alliance travelers approaching from Ashenvale or the Barrens.

angles.text: For the Horde, Mor'shan Rampart guards the Barrens against night elf incursions. It also keeps supply lines to Ashenvale's logging operations open.
Alliance fighters see Mor'shan Rampart as an aggressive barricade. The Warsong clan built it to protect Horde logging and stage raids into Ashenvale.
